policy.catalog: Apply concrete submitted values only to exact approved-HD owners listed on the grouped card; unresolved corners remain open.
policy.materialPairs: Approved directed pairs promote; rejected-only directed pairs demote; approval wins when both outcomes exist.
policy.exactLocationMemory: An exact rejected tile/corner remains suppressed for that exact location even when its material pair is promoted elsewhere.
policy.withdrawnReview: A post-submission withdrawal is unresolved evidence, restores the pre-R147 current assignment, and contributes no pair vote.
